title: GaiaVario.jl: variometric GNSS displacement engine for GaiaSeis
description:
GaiaVario is a variometric GNSS displacement engine written in Julia: for every satellite seen at two consecutive epochs it differences the carrier phase minus the modelled terms (broadcast orbit and clock, Sagnac, troposphere, solid Earth tide, phase wind-up) and solves the station displacement over the pair by weighted least squares with per-satellite rejection. It is the default engine plug-in of the GaiaSeis platform (interface GaiaSeisEngineAPI).

This work is part of the TRANSFORM² project which aims to improve physical and digital infrastructure across Near-Fault Observatories (NFOs) in Europe. TRANSFORM² is funded by the European Union under project number 101188365 within the HORIZON-INFRA-2024-DEV-01-01 call.
